title: Wind a coil with more turns
hook: Change number of turns and predict induced emf magnitude.
misconception: induced emf magnitude stays fixed when number of turns doubles.
objective: Apply emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt) to compare induced emf magnitude when number of turns changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a coil with the same rate of flux change through each identical turn, emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt). When number of turns doubles, induced emf magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a coil with the same rate of flux change through each identical turn, with a nonzero initial result. If number of turns triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on induced emf magnitude?
recall.why: Apply emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
